title: Spicy Mackerel Skewers
description: A fusion of Thai and Venezuelan flavors, these skewers combine the richness of mackerel with the heat of Thai chilies.

ingredients.name: Smoky chilies
ingredients.notes: such as chipotle peppers in adobo sauce

ingredients.name: Venezuelan aji amarillo peppers
ingredients.notes: or substitute with Thai bird's eye chilies

instructions: 2. In a blender or food processor, combine fish marinade ingredients and blend until smooth.
3. Place mackerel fillets in a shallow dish and brush with marinade.
4. Thread mackerel onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Brush skewers with coconut oil and season with salt and pepper.
6. Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
7. Meanwhile, toast aji amarillo peppers in a dry pan over medium heat, turning frequently, until slightly charred.
8. Chop toasted peppers and mix with cilantro.
9. Serve skewers hot with pepper-cilantro sauce spooned over the top.
